usage.finalMessage:
CLIN-23-R1 is done. `prescribe` now refuses doses above the maximum in `docs/formulary.md` and drugs not in the formulary. The limits are in `src/Clinic/Rules.fs`. `dotnet test Clinic.slnx` passes 7/7, including two tests I added.
CLIN-23-R2 is not done: Pharmacy has to check the doses and write the record in `docs/verification/`. I didn't write it myself, because that would be a fake sign-off. CLIN-23 can't be released until Pharmacy does this.
The report is in `.work/report.json`, and everything is committed.
OUTCOME: completed
